picks.title: How KPMG Closed the Design-to-Engineering Gap with Builder
picks.rationale: Most actionable item in the pool: an AI design-intelligence system that drives rule-based component code generation, cutting design-review cycles from 10 days to same-day and delivery time 88% — a concrete design-to-code playbook.
picks.excerpt: KPMG adopted Builder's AI design-intelligence system to close the design-to-engineering gap, cutting delivery time 88% by driving component-based code generation with explicit architectural rules instead of probabilistic pattern inference. Design review cycles dropped from 10 days to same-day turnaround.

picks.title: Otoy releases OctaneRender 2026.4
picks.rationale: Shipped AI render feature: the Neural Radiance Cache (a network trained at render time to denoise indirect light) expands to macOS and network rendering, plus wider 3D Gaussian Splatting — a real speed/quality change for 3D artists.
picks.excerpt: Otoy's GPU renderer update expands the Neural Radiance Cache — a neural network trained at render time to cut noise in indirectly lit scenes — to macOS and network rendering, and extends 3D Gaussian Splatting support.

picks.title: OpenAI gets permission to roll out GPT-5.6 to the public on July 9
picks.rationale: High-novelty frontier release landing today (Jul 9): all three GPT-5.6 variants go public, expanding globally — a model shift that flows straight into designers' daily AI tooling; credible outlet.
picks.excerpt: OpenAI will publicly launch all three GPT-5.6 variants — Sol, Luna and Terra — on July 9 after US government approval, expanding preview access globally. A frontier-model release that will land directly in designers' daily AI tooling.

picks.title: nTop and CoreWeave tackle NASA's Vision 2030 with time to spare
picks.rationale: Concrete generative-engineering milestone: 12,000 CFD sims across 2,400 geometry variants run lights-out, producing a dataset viable for training AI surrogate models that predict aerodynamics without re-simulating — points to where computational design is heading.
picks.excerpt: nTop and CoreWeave ran 12,000 CFD simulations across 2,400 drone geometry variants lights-out, without manual intervention — a dataset the team says is viable for training AI surrogate models that predict aerodynamic performance without re-running simulation.

picks.title: Skill issue: how we built an OS for PMs at Figma | Config 2026
picks.rationale: Distinct Config 2026 session (not the published AI-evals one): a concrete playbook for encoding team workflows into agent Skills as an internal OS — actionable for AI-augmented design/PM teams; single Config pick keeps the ≤2-YouTube guard and avoids repetition.
picks.excerpt: Config 2026 session video: how Figma's team packaged agent Skills into an internal 'operating system' for PMs — a concrete playbook for encoding team workflows into AI agents.
